'''Rudic crystal''' was a rare sort of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] prized for their use in [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] devices. Small deposits could be found on what little land surface there was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hirsi]].
